subject: RE: Mid-cycle capacity top-up & co-term path for CloudScript
messages:
From: Maya Reddy <procurement@cloudscript.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:32 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle capacity top-up request

Hi Lauren / Monica,

Hope you’re well — we’re seeing a material uptick in queries tied to our new vector-based search feature and are approaching our committed units faster than expected. Can you share options for purchasing additional capacity mid-contract and how that would affect our renewal date (we’d prefer to co-term if possible)? Key asks: 

- Quick estimate of incremental monthly cost for +40% capacity (current commit: 1.0M tokens/month)
- Any short-term burst/buffer options to cover May spikes
- If we take an uplift that extends to 12 months, what discount tiers are available?
- What’s required on our side for procurement (PO/DocuSign/amendment cycle)?

I’ve attached a short usage extract so you can see the trend.

Thanks — can we aim to get a short proposal this week? We’re trying to finalize a PO by the 20th.

Best,
Maya Reddy
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudScript
[Attachment: usage_report_may2026.csv (CSV, 85KB)]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Reddy <procurement@cloudscript.ai>, CloudScript POC <cloudscript-poc@cloudscript.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle capacity top-up request

Hi Maya — thanks for the usage extract, that helps a lot. Putting three practical options on the table so procurement can pick the cadence that best fits CloudScript: 

Option 1 — Immediate top-up (short-term surge buffer)
- Add a 40% burst bucket for 30 days
- One-time invoice pro-rated to days remaining in the month (~prorate to 18 days)
- No change to renewal date (keeps original co-term)
- No long-term discount

Option 2 — 12-month uplift (preferred for unit economics)
- Increase committed units by 40% (new commit: 1.4M tokens/month)
- 10% uplift discount on incremental units for a 12-month term; 12% if signed within 7 business days
- Co-terms to existing renewal date (we generate an amendment that annualizes immediately and keeps the same renewal cycle)
- Requires executed amendment + PO or DocuSign signature

Option 3 — Staged top-up + co-term sync
- Immediate 20% burst for 60 days + commit to 20% additional units through next renewal
- Reduced pro-rata invoice now and capped discount (6%) on the committed portion

Next steps I suggest:
- If procurement can confirm which option, we’ll produce a 1-page amendment and a pricing worksheet for legal/procurement review.
- If Option 2 is selected and you sign within 7 business days we can apply the 12% band.

I’ve attached a short pricing worksheet and a draft amendment template for your legal team to scan. If it’s helpful I can also prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: PO submitted, amendment signed, invoice date, and onboarding/ops notes.

Proposed quick call: Thu 14th 10:00–10:30 PT to walk through numbers — does that work?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Enterprise Growth
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_proposal_topup_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: pricing_sheet_topup.xlsx]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:17:45 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mid-cycle capacity top-up request — discount approval?

FW: sending this up the chain — CloudScript is looking at Option 2 with the 12% conditional band (signed in 7 business days).

Quick points:
- Finance: 12% on incremental units for 12 months is within our standard uplift bands for mid-market; we should confirm gross margin impact if we want to push to 14%.
- Legal: the amendment will be a short addendum referencing the original SOW; no special IP terms expected.
- Ops: need to confirm scheduling with Dedicated capacity team to ensure quota is posted same day the amendment goes live.

Aditya — are you comfortable approving 12% as-is? If not, what escalation do you need (discount committee / VP sign-off)?

Ben
Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 11:02 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:32:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle capacity top-up request

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the clear options and the worksheet. We reviewed internally and CloudScript would like to move forward with Option 2 (12-month uplift to 1.4M tokens/month) and lock the conditional 12% discount; we’ll aim to sign within the 7-business day window. Next items from procurement: 

- We need a final amendment (paper) that summarizes the committed increase, new monthly rate, discount band, and effective date.
- We will issue a PO upon review; attaching a signed PO to this reply.
- Please share a DocuSign link for the amendment and confirm the invoice date (we prefer invoice to align with PO effective date).

Attached: PO_CloudScript_0526.pdf

Can you confirm final ARR delta and the monthly invoice amount (line itemized) so our finance team can match it to the PO? We’d like to close this by 20 May.

Best,
Maya
Senior Procurement Manager | CloudScript
[Attachment: PO_CloudScript_0526.pdf]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle capacity top-up request

Maya — fantastic, thanks for the quick confirmation and for attaching the PO. Action items we’ll complete today: 

1) Legal / Finance: finalize the short amendment and set the effective date to 2026-05-21 (this aligns invoicing with your PO).
2) I’ll send a DocuSign envelope with the amendment and the pricing worksheet attached (link below).
3) Ops / Dedicated team will queue the quota increase for activation on 2026-05-21; Ben will confirm once the environment change is scheduled.

Numbers (summary):
- Incremental commit: +40% = +400k tokens/month (from 1.0M to 1.4M)
- List price incremental monthly: $12,000 (pre-discount)
- Applied discount: 12% on incremental units = $1,440 discount
- Net incremental monthly: $10,560
- Annualized ARR delta: $126,720

DocuSign envelope (amendment + pricing): https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-Topup-CloudScript

Ben / Monica — please confirm Ops scheduling and send me the amendment PDF once Legal stamps it so I can route for signature.

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Enterprise Growth
Redwood Inference
